🚨 Update on HMPV Outbreak 🚨

Rumors of a new #virus in #China are false. The reported #HMPV is a common, seasonal virus, not a new threat. The Chinese Embassy has dismissed these claims as "fake news."

Stay informed, avoid misinformation!
